page: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v4 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the EDSv4 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor running at 2.6 GHz, featuring 10 physical cores and 20 vCPUs via hyperthreading on an x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 160.0 GB of dedicated system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local storage is provided via a bundled 768 GB SSD, and the instance supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark evaluations place the E20ds_v4 in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1414.88, while multi-core performance reaches 18605.2. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 1038.89 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 41.59 GB/sec. In database-related tests, the instance achieves 17.23 million operations per second for Redis SET operations and a PassMark database operations score of 7262.76.

While the instance demonstrates average capabilities for general computing, software compilation with a Geekbench score of 15284.0, and static web serving at 14.33 GB/sec, it exhibits performance limitations in large language model workloads. Specifically, LLM text generation for a small 135M model at 71.75 tokens/sec and prompt processing for a medium 7B model at 30.52 tokens/sec fall into the weak performance category. Given the high memory-to-core ratio and local SSD storage, this instance is configured for memory-intensive workloads, database management, and caching systems rather than heavy AI inference.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v4 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance from the EDSv4 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor with 20 dedicated vCPUs, 10 physical cores, and a 2.6 GHz clock speed. The hardware configuration includes 160.0 GB of RAM, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, alongside a bundled 768 GB local SSD. Performance benchmarks generally fall within the average tier, with a PassMark CPU score of 19266.4 and Redis SET operations reaching 17.23 million operations per second. However, the instance shows weak performance in specific LLM tasks, such as text generation for small models and prompt processing for medium models. This server is structured for memory-intensive applications, database operations, and caching workloads that benefit from high memory density and local SSD storage.
